_comment: TAPLab solver registry. Executable locations are supplied per machine via environment variables (TAPLAB_TAPB_EXE, TAPLAB_TAPLITE_EXE, ...); this registry records capabilities and integration status only.

taplite:FW.provenance: modified from Hillel Bar-Gera's tntp FW implementation
taplite:FW.note: adapter present; not yet smoke-tested in TAPLab

aequilibrae.note: adapter present (optional dependency); not yet smoke-tested in TAPLab

task:TAPAS.note: certified on Chicago Sketch via the independent validator; requires TAPLAB_TASK_EXE + params templates

task:LUCE.note: certified on Chicago Sketch via the independent validator; requires TAPLAB_TASK_EXE + params templates

task:GP.note: certified on Chicago Sketch via the independent validator; requires TAPLAB_TASK_EXE + params templates

task:B.note: certified on Chicago Sketch via the independent validator; requires TAPLAB_TASK_EXE + params templates

task:BFW.note: certified on Chicago Sketch via the independent validator; requires TAPLAB_TASK_EXE + params templates

origin_bush:O0.note: controlled monotone-grid harness (origin_bush.exe); generates its own instances — research lane, not a TAPBench adapter. Native generalization: latent_gp

origin_bush:P0.note: controlled monotone-grid harness (origin_bush.exe); generates its own instances — research lane, not a TAPBench adapter. Native generalization: latent_gp

origin_bush:OL1.note: controlled monotone-grid harness (origin_bush.exe); generates its own instances — research lane, not a TAPBench adapter. Native generalization: latent_gp

latent_gp:P0.algorithm: Explicit-path GP (adaptive column generation, Gauss-Seidel diagonal Newton)
latent_gp:P0.provenance: native TAPLab port of the origin_bush_latent research line (P0)

latent_gp:OL1.algorithm: Latent-atom GP: explicit major columns + one nonnegative latent atom per OD
latent_gp:OL1.provenance: native TAPLab generalization of OL1 from the controlled monotone-grid experiment to arbitrary networks
